requirements.title: Stronger seat ventilation and cooling

description.text: US customers need seat ventilation that noticeably cools the seat on hot days and long summer drives.

metric.text: At least 80 % of surveyed US owners rate seat ventilation as satisfactory.

acceptance_criteria.text: Ventilated front seats are available on the US base trim, as on the rival sedan.
The cooling function wins an independent comfort award.

assumptions: Survey ratings are a fair proxy for perceived cooling performance.
uncertainties: No measured airflow or temperature data is in the evidence.

description.text: Customers expect route planning that takes charging stops into account.

acceptance_criteria.text: The navigation proposes charging stops as part of a planned route.

description.text: Customers want climate functions that also cool the seats.
Customers want a feature nobody asked for.
